title: Conversation view
description: A session's conversation: the Chat and Log views, the log-card slot, and everything drawn in or driven from it (file-change and git cards, `!` command runs, file links, answering questions, Bash-change snapshots)

settings.label: Show files changed by Bash commands
settings.description: Snapshots the git working tree around each Bash call (a hook in sessions the app starts) so sed, formatters and scripts show as diff cards. Needs jq and git.

settings.label: Claude settings file to check for a global hook
settings.description: If this file already runs the snapshot hook, sessions the app starts skip adding it a second time.
